title: Webinar Logistics & Campaign Sync - Redwood x Acorn Analytics
summary: Planning call to finalize logistics for joint webinar targeting mid-market SaaS teams. Discussed registrant goals, promotion cadence, speaker roles, slide deck ownership, technical dry-run, tracking/UTMs, and legal approvals for recording. Agreed on a 1,500 registrant target with 30-40% attendance expectation; Redwood to own slides and dry run, Acorn to promote to their list and provide customer case example. Action items assigned and a follow-up dry-run scheduled.
topics: Recording, legal permissions, and gated assets
action_items: Alex Park - Share slide draft and speaker bullets - 2025-03-07
Priya Nambiar - Send Acorn email copy and promo schedule - 2025-03-06
Samira Patel - Create landing page template and UTM parameters - 2025-03-05
Diego Marquez - Coordinate dry-run and test streaming setup - 2025-03-11
Marcus Holt - Provide short customer case bullet points and one slide - 2025-03-09
next_steps: Redwood to publish landing page draft by 2025-03-05
Marketing teams exchange promo calendar and finalize cadence by 2025-03-06
Schedule technical dry-run (Redwood + Acorn + SE) for 2025-03-11 at 10:00 PT
Legal to confirm recording permission and data capture by 2025-03-07
transcript:
Header:
Date: 2025-03-04
Start: 15:00 PT
Duration: ~52 mins
Attendees: Alex (Redwood AE), Samira (Redwood Marketing), Diego (Redwood SE), Nina (Redwood Content), Jared (Acorn Marketing), Priya (Acorn Demand Gen), Marcus (Acorn VP Product)
----
[00:00] Alex (RW): Hey everyone, thanks for hopping on, appreciate you making time. Quick roll call?
[00:08] Jared (Acorn): Jared here.
[00:10] Priya (Acorn): Priya here.
[00:12] Marcus (Acorn): Marcus here.
[00:14] Samira (RW): Samira, Nina and Diego here.
[00:18] Alex (RW): Cool. Agenda — logistics for the Redwood x Acorn webinar, promo timing, registrant targets, slides, tech dry run, and approvals. Anything to add?
[00:28] Priya (Acorn): Nah that's it. Main thing for us is conversion to leads, so we want strong CTAs and gated follow-ups.
[00:36] Marcus (Acorn): And timezones — our EU folks need to be considered, but we mostly target NA.
[00:41] Diego (RW): Technical note — we should confirm platform, streaming, and whether we'll use ON24 or Zoom. Redwood prefers Zoom for smaller webinars but can adapt.
[00:50] Jared (Acorn): We have an ON24 seat but the marketing ops team prefers Zoom for simple registration. Both ok.
[00:56] Samira (RW): Ok, let's talk numbers. What are Acorn's typical attendee rates? And what target should we set?
[01:05] Priya (Acorn): For co-marketed webinars, registrants usually 800-1,200; attendance 25-35%. If we push to our full list maybe 1.2k.
[01:14] Alex (RW): Redwood's goal here — we'd like 1,500 registrants, optimistic but possible with joint promos and paid. Expected attendance ~30% so ~450 live attendees. That feels reasonable?
[01:24] Marcus (Acorn): 1,500 is ambitious for us but if Redwood commits to paid social and the list, sure. What's budget?
[01:30] Samira (RW): We can allocate a small paid social budget — $2k-$4k — primarily LinkedIn. Also want to run an email nurture and two reminder sequences.
[01:40] Priya (Acorn): We can commit to two sends to our product-list and one to broader marketing list. Need the copy by Monday so we can schedule.
[01:48] Alex (RW): Action — Priya will send email copy by 2025-03-06. Samira will provide recommended send times and cadence.
[01:54] Nina (RW): Content — who will own the slides and speaker bullets? We propose Redwood owns the main deck and provides Acorn with a co-branded version. Marcus, you'll provide a customer case slide?
[02:05] Marcus (Acorn): Yes, I can give one slide and bullets. Need to know format — 3 bullet points and a quick metric would be ideal.
[02:12] Diego (RW): We'll also need a brief tech slide about how Redwood routes inference and a simplified diagram — but we should avoid heavy architecture detail for marketing audience.
[02:20] Alex (RW): Good point — high-level only. Also we need a 10-minute window for Q&A and a CTA to request a trial or demo.
[02:28] Jared (Acorn): About the CTA — gated content would be great. Can we offer a downloadable checklist or benchmark summary?
[02:34] Samira (RW): Yes, Redwood can produce a 1-page benchmark summary (tokens, latency, cost takeaways) and a checklist for choosing inference platforms. We'll gate it behind a signup form.
[02:44] Priya (Acorn): Great — that will help lead gen. For tracking, what UTM params do we want? Also need consolidated landing page.
[02:52] Samira (RW): We'll standardize utm_source=acorn|redwood, utm_medium=email|paid, utm_campaign=redwood-acorn-webinar-march25. Samira to create landing page template and share by 2025-03-05.
[03:05] Alex (RW): Date — are we confirmed for March 25th at 10:00 PT? That was the proposal.
[03:10] Priya (Acorn): That works for us. EU folks may miss but we'll record.
[03:14] Marcus (Acorn): Recording ok, but legal wants sign-off for customer quotes — need a release.
[03:20] Alex (RW): We'll loop in legal. Action: Legal sign-off on recording and quotes by 2025-03-07.
[03:26] Diego (RW): Dry-run — recommend two tech rehearsals: one internal with speakers to rehearse transitions and stack, and one final hour-long run with the platform. Can we do 2025-03-11 for the full dry-run?
[03:37] Priya (Acorn): Yes 03/11 works on our side. Prefer morning PT.
[03:40] Samira (RW): Diego to lead dry-run and test slides, screen-share latency, mic checks. Also test the gated asset download flow.
[03:49] Jared (Acorn): Who's doing the moderation? Will Redwood moderate or Acorn?
[03:53] Alex (RW): Redwood can moderate. We'll prepare intro and Q&A handling guidelines. Marcus will take product questions and jump in for case study section.
[04:02] Nina (RW): Timeline for slide deck — Redwood draft to be shared by 2025-03-07. Then Acorn provides edits and Marcus' case slide by 2025-03-09.
[04:12] Priya (Acorn): For promo — we'll run three email sends: initial, reminder 48 hours, day-of. Also social posts week-of. Jared will map channels and give our list counts.
[04:22] Jared (Acorn): Quick note — we've seen better attendance when we offer a follow-up 15-min office hours instead of a long Q&A. Might be worth offering a signup for office hours post-webinar.
[04:33] Alex (RW): Good idea. Add that as an experiment. We'll measure conversion.
[04:36] Priya (Acorn): Any special compliance concerns? Capturing PII on landing page ok?
[04:41] Alex (RW): Standard contact info only. If any customer case includes sensitive metrics, Marcus will redact and provide approval.
[04:48] Marcus (Acorn): I'll make sure it's cleared. Also want to avoid calling out competitor names in slides; marketing ops recommends generic comparisons.
[04:55] Diego (RW): On the technical side, I want to flag a potential transcription issue — automated captions sometimes mangle product names, e.g., Redwood Inference can come out as "Redwood in for cents" — we'll manually correct captions in the recording.
[05:07] Samira (RW): Good catch. Also add brand guidelines: Acorn wants co-branding at 60/40 Acorn/Redwood. We'll follow their logo usage.
[05:16] Alex (RW): Ok let's recap actions. Alex — slide draft and speaker bullets by 03/07. Samira — landing page and UTMs by 03/05. Priya — email copy by 03/06. Marcus — case slide by 03/09. Diego — dry-run on 03/11 and test streaming. Legal sign-off by 03/07. Jared — promo counts and channel map by 03/06.
[05:35] Priya (Acorn): Sounds good. Can we get the slide template in a Google Slides link?
[05:40] Nina (RW): Yes, we'll share GSlides and a speaker notes doc.
[05:44] Jared (Acorn): One more question — recordings: will Redwood host the recording and provide the gated link or do we host?
[05:50] Alex (RW): Redwood can host the recording and provide the gated asset; we'll share analytics. If Acorn prefers to host, we can share the master MP4.
[05:58] Marcus (Acorn): Redwood host is fine.
[06:00] Samira (RW): Any last items?
[06:03] Priya (Acorn): No. Thanks everyone.
[06:05] Alex (RW): Thanks — we'll follow up with the slide link and action list. Meeting end.
----
Notes on transcription: occasional speaker attribution errors and a few stutters removed. Time stamps approximate every 30-90s.
notes: Co-marketing webinar; agreed date March 25th; dry-run on March 11th; key deliverables and owners listed in action_items; recording/legal sign-off needed.
